mode: verbatim memory-file ingest into OpenViking, feiyu-memgate openviking backend (read-only store), default recall stages, precise recall profile, bge-m3 embeddings inside OpenViking, no LLM
how: config.build_gateway(dict); OpenVikingBackend.put(text, ref=viking://~/memories/events/Y/M/D/<id>.md) per memory; OpenVikingBackend.find(query, 10) for ranked; Gateway.recall('owner', {'query': q}) for deployed; id = file name of the item's URI
notes: Memories written with OpenVikingBackend.put (content/write, mode create) as memory files, no session or extraction, so no language model is used; llm_tokens is 0. Ingest went into its own OpenViking user.
ingest_seconds includes the wait until a sample of 21 memories (and the last one written) found themselves (wait 69.4 s; writes alone 2.4 s, 0 put failure(s)).
ranked: backend.find(query, 10) of the read-only store; directory summaries (.abstract.md, .overview.md) are skipped by the backend itself, so ranked can hold fewer than 10 items.

deployed uses the default recall stages (min_score, relative_score, newer_first, fill_text, drop_oversize, redact, dedupe, budget) with [recall] profile = 'precise' pinned and the default limit of 5; the gateway asks the backend for 15 candidates; ms times that Gateway.recall call only. The backend maps OpenViking's raw score with its default floor 0.50 / ceil 1.00 (raw kept in Hit.meta); its precise lines are min_score 0.55 and relative ratio 0.95, its broad lines (the default profile) 0.55 and 0.90, so the min_score in use, 0.55, means raw 0.775.
Backend and gateway timeouts are the defaults (backend socket timeout 2 s) except for ingest writes (30 s).
Recall item ids: the memory id is the file name of the item's URI (id field); 0 item(s) unmapped.
0 recall call(s) did not answer 200; 0 backend find call(s) for ranked failed.
Gateway.recall was called directly, so the per-client rate limiter was not involved.
